subject: Ember-7B onboarding: pin request & compatibility checks
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Ember Onboarding <onboarding@ember.ai>
Date: 2026-11-09T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Ember-7B onboarding: request for pin + compatibility checks

Hi team,

Ember (cc'd) is asking to onboard Ember-7B (v1.2) into our hosted catalog and to be pinned for a short initial period while they validate latency/cost for their production rollout. High-level asks from Product/Partnerships:

- Provide a compatibility report (quantization, KV cache behavior, memory footprint)
- Recommend a pin policy (suggested: pin to v1.2 for 30 days with canary rollback triggers)
- Confirm expected p95 latency on our smallest dedicated footprint and a rough per-token cost delta vs. baseline model
- Surface any gating/security blockers we should expect (PII, logging, encryption)

Attachments: ember_model_spec.pdf (model card + runtime notes). Ember has shared a tarball of artifacts but asked that we coordinate rollout and any pin exceptions from our side before they go live.

Timeline: can we get an internal compat sweep and a proposed pin policy by EOD 2026-11-16? This is tied to deal D-9832 and the partner wants predictable performance for their pilot.

Next steps: Dev / Rishi — can you confirm owners for the compat check and who will own the pin exception request? Laura / Security — can you weigh in on any immediate blockers?

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Product Partnerships
Redwood Inference

--
Olga Petrov
Product Partnerships | Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ember Onboarding <onboarding@ember.ai>
Date: 2026-11-09T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Ember-7B onboarding: request for pin + compatibility checks

Thanks Olga — happy to take the lead on the compat sweep. Quick notes from runtime/serving perspective:

- Immediate items we'll check: quantization friendliness (int8/4-bit profile), KV cache correctness with sharded KV (we've seen edge cases for >8k context with some models), attention kernel compatibility for rotary embeddings, and peak GPU memory for batch sizes of 1/4/8.
- Canary plan: propose dedicated canary pool (single AZ), pin to v1.2 for 30 days, automatic fallback to r4-small-compat or our current baseline if regressions detected.
- Eval: please provide Ember's representative prompt set and a 1k prompt holdout for regression testing. We'll run both quality (LM score / exact-match / rouge per their targets) and perf (p95 latency, throughput at 8 concurrent requests).
- Artifacts: we need the model tarball link and the tokenizer files. Ember, can you share the artifact link and a small sample of high-frequency prompts?

I'll run the compat sweep starting Monday and aim to have a short report + recommended pin policy by 2026-11-16 as requested. Possible blockers: unusual ops in the graph that prevent fused kernels — if present, we may need a variant build which can add ~5 business days.

Dev
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ember Onboarding <onboarding@ember.ai>
Date: 2026-11-09T13:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Ember-7B onboarding: request for pin + compatibility checks

Hi all,

Security/compliance notes:

- We'll need Ember to complete our lightweight model security questionnaire before we do any customer-facing rollout. I've attached the standard questionnaire (security_questionnaire.docx). Key items: data retention for logs, inference telemetry retention period, and whether the model can be configured to suppress debug logging that may contain user-provided content.
- For a pin exception we need an explicit statement on PII handling and confirmation that any debug dumps are either disabled or routed to Ember's S3 with server-side encryption (KMS).
- Encryption: confirm model artifacts are signed and checksummed; we require HTTPS transfer + signed URL access for ingestion into our infra.
- If Ember requires us to retain more verbose logs for their debugging, we need a signed data-handling addendum.

From a gating perspective, none of these are blockers, but they are preconditions for hosted catalog onboarding. If you want to limit risk during the first 30 days, standard approach is: pin in a dedicated canary pool, restrict routing to partner traffic only, set logs to 7-day retention, and require an SOC2/attestation on request.

Laura Bennett
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

> On 2026-11-09 11:03, Dev Patel wrote:
> > I'll run the compat sweep starting Monday and aim to have a short report + recommended pin policy by 2026-11-16 as requested.
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ember Onboarding <onboarding@ember.ai>
Date: 2026-11-09T16:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Ember-7B onboarding: request for pin + compatibility checks

Thanks — I'm fine approving a short pin exception with the following constraints:

1) Pin target: Ember-7B v1.2 only, duration: 30 days from go-live.
2) Deployment: must start in a dedicated canary pool restricted to Ember traffic (no general public routing).
3) Metrics gating: automatic rollback if quality regression > 2% on the agreed eval set or if p95 latency exceeds target by > 30% for two consecutive days.
4) Security preconditions: questionnaire complete and confirmation on log retention/encryption.

Operational asks for Product/Partnerships: please add the eval set and the target acceptance criteria to the deal sheet (D-9832). Dev — assign an owner for the automated rollback job and let me know what alert thresholds you want in Radar.

If everyone agrees, I'll sign off on the pin exception and we can coordinate a go/no-go cadence next Friday (2026-11-16).

Rishi Malhotra
Director, Serving Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

From: Ember Onboarding <onboarding@ember.ai>

Date: 2026-11-09T17:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Ember-7B onboarding: request for pin + compatibility checks

Hi Olga / team — thanks for the quick follow-up and the proposed plan. A few answers/requests from our side:

- We will complete the security_questionnaire.docx by Tuesday morning and can provide SOC2 attestation excerpts on request.
- Artifact link (read-only): gs://ember-artifacts/ember-7b/v1.2/model.tar.gz (we've also shared tokenizer files). Please confirm the ingestion method you prefer; signed GCS URL is fine.
- Eval prompts: https://drive.ember.ai/ember-7b/eval-prompts (read-only sample).
- We accept the canary + rollback constraints you outlined. One ask: during the pinned period, can you allow a controlled sampling of debug traces (anonymized) for 48 hours if we show a spike in latency so we can triage? We'll send proposed redaction rules for PII.

Happy to hop on a 30-minute sync tomorrow if helpful.

—Sam Cho
Ember Onboarding
